extended:
**A basis for the full Homfly skein of the annulus**

*RICHARD J. HADJI 1 and HUGH R. MORTON*

27 pp, 17 sections.

**Abstract.** A basis, denoted {Qλ,µ}, for the full Homﬂy skein of the annulus C was introduced in [18], where λ and µ are partitions of integers n and p into k and k∗parts respectively. The basis consists of eigenvectors of the two meridian maps on C; these maps are the linear endomorphisms of C induced by the insertion of a meridian loop with either orientation around a diagram in the annulus. In this paper we give an explicit expression for each Qλ,µ as the determinant of a (k∗+ k) × (k∗+ k) matrix whose entries are simple elements hn, h∗ n in the skein C. In the case p = 0 (µ = φ) the deter- minant gives the Jacobi-Trudy formula for the Schur function sλ of N variables as a polynomial in the complete symmetric functions hn of the variables, [12].

**Outline.** Front matter; The skein models; The plane; The Hecke algebras and extended variants; The annulus; The annulus with two boundary points; Skein involutions; Some basic elements in the annulus; The meridian maps of the skein C; Relations between C and A; Matrix-based calculations; Notation; Calculations; Eigenvectors of the meridian maps; Construction of Q,; Properties of the basis elements Q,; (1,1)-tangle invariants
